description: Search the indexed codebase. Returns matching code chunks with file paths, line numbers, and relevance scores. Modes: keyword (FTS5), semantic (vector), hybrid (RRF fusion), auto (heuristic when SEARCH_AUTO_ROUTE), symbol (SQLite symbol index by identifier), regex (pattern matching with /pattern/flags). Results are cached (LRU, 5min TTL) for non-regex modes. Filter by symbol_kind to only see files with functions, classes, etc. Enable fuzzy:true to boost results with approximate string matching (Levenshtein) — useful for misspelled queries. Post-retrieval ordering: if RERANK_URL is set, the server POSTs {query, documents} for optional cross-encoder-style scores; if not set, results are still reordered by Qdrant semantic similarity (no extra service). Ollama (OLLAMA_URL + OLLAMA_MODEL) is only for embeddings at index/query time—not the same as RERANK_URL. Agents: you do not need to "enable" rerank manually unless the user asks to skip it (use rerank:false) or tune env; default behavior is already optimal for most tasks. Prefer a narrow file_pattern and a small limit on the first pass.

content_mode.description: Snippet length: compact (default) or full chunk text

dedupe_by_file.description: If true, at most one chunk per file (best score). Set false to allow multiple chunks from the same file.

expand_context.description: Number of adjacent chunks to include before/after each result for more context (0 = no expansion)

fuzzy.description: Enable fuzzy search re-ranking — boosts results with high Levenshtein similarity to query terms. Useful for misspelled queries or approximate matching. Default follows SEARCH_FUZZY_ENABLED env var (false).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

max_content_chars.description: Max characters per chunk body when content_mode is compact

mode.description: keyword | semantic | hybrid | auto (needs SEARCH_AUTO_ROUTE) | symbol (lookup by symbol name) | regex (pattern matching with /pattern/flags syntax)

query.description: Search query — natural language, keywords, or a symbol name when mode is symbol

rerank.description: When false, skip post-retrieval reorder (HTTP rerank if RERANK_URL is set, else semantic reorder by Qdrant scores). Default follows SEARCH_RERANK. Use false for speed or when raw hybrid/semantic order is preferred.

symbol_kind.description: Filter results to only files containing symbols of this kind: function, class, method, interface, type, variable, enum, or export

name: search
